title: Replace your app subscriptions with this set of 27 lifetime licenses bundled together for $30
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Get 27 native Mac apps with lifetime licenses in one bundle for $29.99 (reg. $390).

Buying Mac utilities one at a time, or renting them through monthly subscriptions, is laughably expensive. It’s also not your only option. This Mac Bundle collects 27 native macOS apps for everything from productivity and file cleanup to development, design, and media, all under lifetime licenses on sale for $29.99 (reg. $390).

You might already be paying a monthly fee for tasks some of these apps do for a one-time fee.

When your Mac slows down, MemoryBooster frees inactive memory to bring the speed back. AllClips saves your clipboard history, so a link you copied this morning is still one click away in the afternoon. RenameMe cleans up a cluttered folder by batch-renaming files with a live preview before you commit anything.

Developers get their own toolkit, from Regex Wizard for testing expressions to JSON Wizard for editing data and CodeCounter for measuring a project’s size. Designers can pull color palettes out of any image with Color Hound, batch-process photos in PhotoFoundry, and manage fonts in Specimen. Secure file deletion, automatic sorting, and QR code generation round out the rest.

Every app runs natively on macOS and includes free updates through its next major version, so you’re not paying again down the road.
